segments.name: Recorded Music
segments.description: Signs, develops and markets recording artists, selling and licensing their recordings through digital services, physical formats and artist services.
segments.evidence: Recorded Music mainly involves selling, marketing, distribution and licensing of recorded music produced by the Company's recording artists.

segments.name: Music Publishing
segments.description: Owns and licenses musical compositions for songwriters, earning royalties when works are performed, reproduced, synchronized or sold as sheet music.
segments.evidence: Music Publishing revenues are earned from the receipt of royalties relating to the licensing of rights in musical compositions and the sale of published sheet music and songbooks.

revenueModel.text: Digital platforms such as Spotify, YouTube and Apple and record buyers pay the company for licensed access to recordings and compositions, physical products and artist services.
revenueModel.evidence: In the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025, the Company had three customers, Spotify, YouTube and Apple, that individually represented 10% or more of total revenues

changes.text: In 2025 the Company agreed to sell its EMP business within Recorded Music and classified it as held for sale.
changes.evidence: In the fourth quarter of 2025, the Company signed a non-binding letter of intent to sell its EMP business within our Recorded Music segment and was classified as held for sale.

changes.text: In 2024 the Company divested certain sound recording and publishing rights and certain non-core owned and operated media properties.
changes.evidence: During the fiscal year ended September 30, 2024, the Company recognized a pre-tax gain of $ 32 million in connection with the divestiture of certain sound recording and publishing rights and certain non-core owned and operated media properties.
